stack_wine.note: Three boundaries match the public TAPAS StackWine five-demo cohort; live DynaMAC demos remain a local cohort and require plot inspection.

place_cups.note: Use the single retained gripper-close event as the contact anchor; select the immediately preceding approach stop, immediately following lift stop, and final pre-release stop. This fixes phase alignment without pinning demonstration indices; exact author settings remain unavailable.

open_microwave.note: All five live demonstrations contain the same two merged velocity/gripper boundary groups.

wipe_desk.note: The upstream expert remains one continuous CartesianPath. The generic demonstrated-EE direction-reversal signal exposes its five physical fold points without reading task names or simulator waypoints; the velocity/gripper union retains grasp, path entry, and completion, and temporal consensus removes incidental planner slowdowns while retaining the gripper anchor.

bimanual_put_bottle_in_fridge.note: Keep the two gripper transitions when present; velocity candidates only fill a missing transition at the cohort's median normalized times.

bimanual_handover_item.note: Merge each arm's nearby velocity/gripper candidates, then merge the shared union and require six boundaries.

bimanual_lift_tray.note: Two cohort-consistent boundary groups on the collected five demos; must be checked against a debug plot or author metadata.

bimanual_sweep_to_dustpan.note: Four cohort-consistent boundary groups on the collected five demos; must be checked against a debug plot or author metadata.
